description: Work out monthly and annual recurring revenue from paying customers and average revenue per customer, plus new, churned and net new MRR and where MRR stands in 12 months at the given sign-up and churn rates. Send numbers only (percentages as 5 for 5%). Answers a headline, the figures behind it and notes. Arithmetic on your own numbers, not financial advice. Answers from what you send alone: nothing is fetched or stored.

arpa.description: Average revenue per customer, per month

churn.description: Customers lost per month (%). The share of customers who cancel in a month. Optional.

currency.description: The sign money is written with; "none" for bare numbers. Default "$".

name: calculate_mrr
title: Calculate MRR and ARR
